The local clock merge preserves both accepted lifecycle fixture and A1 clock parents and resolves only imports/publication dates in the conflicted test.

Current API, material state and project state readers pass the explicit retained event and state.

A stale A assessment cannot support current B or pending B. An actual A-to-B-to-A return restores the same retained event without duplication; a failed or pending refresh retains an unchanged current accepted version only when its full binding still matches. Withdrawal support requires the current explicit withdrawal flag and bound same-article project, so an accepted positive permit cannot be relabelled as withdrawal.

The data-center classifier cannot borrow a generic permit from a named warehouse despite an old data-center project tag; explicit correctly named campus clauses remain positive. Issued building/electrical permits remain permitting; construction needs begun/underway physical evidence, with commercial tier unaffected.
